steps.title: Sterile Field Setup
steps.instruction: Open sterile kit onto a clean surface without touching the interior. Verify all required supplies are present.

steps.title: Hand Hygiene
steps.instruction: Perform hand hygiene with soap and water or alcohol-based rub for at least 20 seconds.

steps.title: Site Preparation
steps.instruction: Clean insertion site with chlorhexidine gluconate using back-and-forth scrubbing motion for 30 seconds. Allow to dry completely.

steps.title: Gloving
steps.instruction: Don sterile gloves using proper technique. Do not touch non-sterile surfaces after gloving.

steps.title: Draping
steps.instruction: Apply full-body sterile drape over patient, exposing only the insertion site. Confirm drape is secure.

steps.title: Catheter Placement
steps.instruction: Insert catheter using sterile technique. Confirm venous access via blood return before advancing.

steps.title: Line Confirmation
steps.instruction: Confirm line position. Flush all lumens with normal saline and verify patency.

steps.title: Dressing Application
steps.instruction: Apply sterile transparent dressing over insertion site. Ensure dressing is flat with no air gaps.

steps.title: Procedure Complete
steps.instruction: Document insertion site, date, time, and clinician. Discard sharps and dispose of waste per protocol.
